 THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:7860  WP No. 103674 of 2021  ORDER
Learned HCGP for respondent No.1-State is present.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has not complied the office objections.
On 05.06.2024, this Court had directed the petitioner to comply the office objections failing which the matter would be listed for dismissal of the petition.
Inspite of specific directions issued by this Court, the petitioner has not complied the office objections, which shows that the petitioner is not interested in prosecuting the petition.
Hence, the petition is dismissed for non-compliance of office objections and non-prosecution.
